tagline: Pure white canvas of rounded bento cards with one tinted hero card per slide, oversized Playfair numerals and tiny uppercase English labels.

palette.description: white ground, one blue with same-hue tints, five supporting hues used only as number colours

typography.style: high-contrast serif for titles and giant numbers, neutral sans for labels and body

best_for: Metrics-led presentations where each slide is a small dashboard of cards: product launches, platform keynotes, annual reviews.
avoid_for: Narrative or quote-driven talks; the card grid breaks up long sentences.
name: Bento White
